plan.title: Duplicate product merges into one line

steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation screen with its default Auction stage.
Provide the required event title without making the item-merge behavior depend on a specific title.
Apply a pricing template before adding products.
Select the same product twice so both additions use the same product and default variant.
Verify that the duplicate product and variant were merged into one line item rather than retained as two rows.
